title: MathRecords: search and verification software for mixed van der Waerden numbers
description: Search and verification software for mixed van der Waerden numbers w(j+2; 2^j, t_1, t_2), together with the lower-bound colorings, the SAT refutations and the replayed DRAT proof objects that establish five new terms of the OEIS sequences A217005, A217007, A217058, A217059 and A217236. Lower bounds are explicit colorings checkable by a standard-library-only program that never invokes a solver; upper bounds are SAT refutations, with per-cube DRAT proofs replayed under drat-trim and a separate machine-checked proof that the cube set is exhaustive.
